items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Played for a while with Emperor Jones. [INTERVIEWER] No. [INTERVIEWER] That's wrong, huh?

ctx.x: They had something. The promotion promotion was terrific. I think that's what jazz needs and the band was a good band. A very good band but they were going to Atlanta and I just left St. Louis, I didn't want to go to Atlanta, you know. I had no ideas about going to Atlanta so I had a couple of dollars so I say, well, let's go to New York. I heard about these bands in New York ... so ... I go to a place called the Lenox Club and there is a fellow by the name of Sam Wooding has a band there.
Now what about this mention about work for a while with Emperor Jones.
